petrol.what: National average retail price of regular gasoline, cash, survey date Mon Nov 9, 2026 (previous week 170.0)
petrol.source: Agency for Natural Resources and Energy (METI), Petroleum Product Price Survey, result summary published Wed Nov 11, 2026
petrol.file_read: docx/261111.docx, read in the browser, not saved
petrol.caveat: Price on Nov 9, 2026, not March 2027. The survey is a national average; rural and expressway-service-area prices are usually higher (inference, not measured).

economy_wltc_km_per_l.source: Suzuki Motor, release of Nov 13, 2023, fuel consumption rate (WLTC mode), table of Wagon R grades listed in that release
economy_wltc_km_per_l.caveat: Only the FX grades are in that release. The hybrid grades are not read. The rental company decides the actual car (usually listed as Wagon R or similar). WLTC is a lab test figure; real driving, with winter tyres, heater and mountain roads, is usually worse (inference).

method: litres = route km / economy; yen = litres x yen per litre. Route km are the OSRM draft distances on the dashboard (no detours, no local driving beyond the plan). Computed by tools/build_fuel.py. Estimate, not a quote.
